dt = frame time; normalize(v) = v / |v|; dot = scalar product; clamp limits a value to a range.

Degree to radian
theta = angle_in_degrees * pi / 180
Use radians inside sin and cos.

Translation
x' = x + Tx; y' = y + Ty; z' = z + Tz
Move a local point to a new position.

Scaling
x' = Sx*x; y' = Sy*y; z' = Sz*z

Rotation about X
x' = x
y' = y*cos(theta) - z*sin(theta)
z' = y*sin(theta) + z*cos(theta)
Rotate limbs or tilted objects about X.

Rotation about Y
x' = x*cos(theta) + z*sin(theta)
y' = y
z' = -x*sin(theta) + z*cos(theta)
Rotate gates, animals and fans about Y.

Rotation about Z
x' = x*cos(theta) - y*sin(theta)
y' = x*sin(theta) + y*cos(theta)
z' = z

Model and clip position
M = Parent * T * R * S
p_world = M * p_local
p_clip = Projection * View * p_world
Scale first, then rotate, translate and apply the parent.

Homogeneous divide
p_NDC = (x_clip / w_clip, y_clip / w_clip, z_clip / w_clip)
OpenGL converts clip coordinates to normalized coordinates.

Distance and direction
d = sqrt((Bx-Ax)^2 + (By-Ay)^2 + (Bz-Az)^2)
u = (B - A) / d, for d > 0
Distance between two points and the unit travel direction.

Movement toward a target
p_new = p_old + u * min(speed * dt, d)
dt is time since the previous frame. The min prevents overshoot.

Travel time
time = distance / speed, for speed > 0
Calculation used in the project notebook.

Facing angle
yaw_deg = atan2(-direction_z, direction_x) * 180 / pi
Animal models face along their local +X axis.

Ellipse path
x = centre_x + radius_x*cos(alpha)
y = centre_y
z = centre_z + radius_z*sin(alpha)
Calves and mobile birds follow elliptical paths.

Path angle update
Calf: alpha_new = (alpha + dir*speed*0.42*dt) mod (2*pi)
Bird: alpha_new = (alpha + dir*speed*dt) mod (2*pi)
alpha is in radians. Negative wrapped angles are shifted by 2*pi.

Fan and gate angle
Fan: angle_new = (angle + 320*dt) mod 360
Gate: step = angular_speed*dt
time_to_open = abs(target_angle - start_angle) / angular_speed
Speeds: entrance/stalls 60 deg/s, calf door 180 deg/s.

Entrance gate free ends
Left: x = -3.82 + 3.82*cos(theta)
Right: x = 3.82 - 3.82*cos(theta)
Both: z = 15.47 - 3.82*sin(theta)
Closed at 0 degrees and fully open at 90 degrees.

Stall and calf door free ends
Stall: (x,z) = (hinge_x + 4*cos(theta), -11.05 - 4*sin(theta))
Calf door: (x,z) = (-6.06 + 1.24*sin(theta), -10.24 + 1.24*cos(theta))
Stall target is -88 degrees. Calf door target is 92 degrees.

Fence placement
N = max(1, ceil(length / 2.7))
P_i = A + (i/N)*(B - A), i = 0, 1, ..., N
Divide each fence run into sections and place its posts.
phi is latitude and theta is longitude in radians.
Cone radius is 0.5 and full height is 1.
Each milk can segment returns radius and height.
Used to calculate the milk can surface normal.

Surface of revolution
S(t,theta) = (r(t)*cos(theta), y(t), r(t)*sin(theta))
Revolve the milk can profile around Y.
Use four consecutive controls at a time to form the pipe centreline.
side and up are perpendicular unit vectors around the pipe.
Local roof point. Add (-10,0,-8) for its world coordinate.
Panel placement and rotation along the billboard curve.

Camera direction and view
Front = normalize(cos(yaw)*cos(pitch), sin(pitch), sin(yaw)*cos(pitch))
Right = normalize(Front cross WorldUp)
Up = normalize(Right cross Front)
View = lookAt(eye, eye + Front, Up)
yaw and pitch are converted to radians for trigonometry.

Projection sizes
aspect = viewport_width / viewport_height
Ortho: full_height = 2*h; full_width = 2*h*aspect
Perspective: fov = camera.Zoom; near = 0.1; far = 150
h is orthographic half-height. Technical views use near/far 0.1/120.

Static box collision
eye_y <= box_height + 1.8
AND x+r > minX AND x-r < maxX
AND z+r > minZ AND z-r < maxZ
The code expands the box by camera radius r = 0.38.

Tree collision
sqrt((x-tree_x)^2 + (z-tree_z)^2) < 0.72
Check only when eye_y < 7.6
0.72 is the complete distance threshold used in the code.

Distance to a gate segment
t = clamp(((p-A) dot (B-A)) / |B-A|^2, 0, 1)
Q = A + t*(B-A)
d = |p-Q|
In XZ: collide if d < 0.48 for entrance, or d < 0.46 for doors.

Swept camera movement
steps = max(1, ceil(move_distance / 0.10))
P_i = previous + (i/steps)*(requested - previous)
Check intermediate positions so movement cannot jump through walls.
Keeps lighting normals correct after scaling and rotation.

Phong light factors
diffuse_factor = max(N dot L, 0)
R = reflect(-L, N)
specular_factor = max(V dot R, 0)^shininess
N, L and V are unit vectors. V points toward the viewer.

Point light attenuation
attenuation = 1 / (constant + linear*d + quadratic*d^2)
d is distance from the light to the surface.

Spotlight intensity
eta = L dot normalize(-spot_direction)
epsilon = max(cos(inner_angle)-cos(outer_angle), 0.0001)
intensity = clamp((eta-cos(outer_angle))/epsilon, 0, 1)
The entrance spotlight uses inner 19 deg and outer 29 deg.

Texture coordinates
(u_final, v_final) = (u*uvScale_x, v*uvScale_y)
albedo = texture_RGB * objectTint
Repeat textures and tint the sampled colour.

Area calculations
Rectangle: A = length * width
Ellipse: A = pi * radius_x * radius_z
Union of two areas: A_total = A1 + A2 - overlap
Calculation notebook equations, not runtime movement equations.

Cuboid volume
V = length * width * height
Used for the water tank and rectangular solids in the notebook.
